description: A Long Island country cover band led by singer and guitarist Casey Wayne, with a second singer, bass and drums. They play modern country hits plus some classic country at country nights where line dancing is welcome, such as Country Wednesdays at 89 North in Patchogue.

evidence.note: 89 North (Patchogue) calendar lists 'Country Wednesday with Casey Wayne & The Rodeo' on Wed Oct 28, with line dance lessons and a country DJ.
Promoter Giotopia profiles the band as a Long Island 'party country' act: Casey Wayne (vocals/guitar), Donna Domingo (vocals/guitar), Carmine Gonzalez (bass), Keith Ross (drums).
Directory mirror of the band's Facebook page (Central Islip, NY; Musicians/Bands) with posts about their March 2026 debut at 89 North; gives the Facebook page ID.
